title: Microsoft confirms Copilot ‘super app’ coming this year

paragraphs.text: The app will merge Copilot’s chat, coding, and agentic features.
paragraphs.translation: 此應用程式將合併 Copilot 的聊天、程式編寫及代理功能。

paragraphs.text: Microsoft is working on an AI “super app” that combines Copilot’s chat, coding, and agentic capabilities. During an earnings call on Wednesday, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said the app will span “both consumer and commercial experiences” when it launches this year.
paragraphs.translation: 微軟正在開發一款 AI「超級應用程式」，該程式結合了 Copilot 的聊天、程式編寫及代理能力。在週三的財報電話會議上，微軟執行長薩提亞·納德拉表示，這款應用程式在今年推出時，將涵蓋「消費端與商業端的體驗」。

paragraphs.text: “Copilot is evolving rapidly from chat to Cowork to Autopilots,” Nadella said. “This quarter, we are bringing these Copilot experiences together, including code, in one super app… This is a major step forward, and I look forward to sharing more soon.”
paragraphs.translation: 納德拉表示：「Copilot 正在從聊天迅速進化到協作（Cowork）再到自動駕駛（Autopilots）。本季，我們正在將這些 Copilot 的體驗整合在一起，包括程式碼在內，變成一個超級應用程式……這是向前邁出的重大一步，我期待很快能分享更多資訊。」

paragraphs.text: Nadella’s confirmation comes months after a report from Fortune revealed that Microsoft is working on a super app that blends its Copilot chatbot, GitHub Copilot coding assistant, Copilot Cowork, and its agentic Autopilot system. Along with Microsoft, OpenAI recently revealed its new ChatGPT Work app, which combines ChatGPT and its AI coding tool Codex.
paragraphs.translation: 納德拉的證實是在《財富》雜誌的一篇報導揭露微軟正在開發一款混合其 Copilot 聊天機器人、GitHub Copilot 程式編寫助手、Copilot Cowork 以及其代理式 Autopilot 系統的超級應用程式幾個月後發布的。除了微軟之外，OpenAI 最近也展示了其新的 ChatGPT Work 應用程式，該程式結合了 ChatGPT 及其 AI 程式編寫工具 Codex。

paragraphs.text: Microsoft’s revenue jumped to $90 billion over the past quarter, with its AI and cloud businesses driving the increase.
paragraphs.translation: 微軟上一季的營收躍升至 900 億美元，其 AI 和雲端業務推動了這一增長。
